mapper.insert: insert into review (order_id, user_id, provider_id, service_id, score, service_score, speed_score, quality_score, content, images, is_anonymous, reply, reply_time, status, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{providerId}, #{serviceId}, #{score}, #{serviceScore}, #{speedScore}, #{qualityScore}, #{content}, #{images}, #{isAnonymous}, #{reply}, #{replyTime}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from review where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc
